notes.title: New Version of Persona5: The Phantom X Now Available
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/e64aa008d7ba4a2d21b5eb56f010917071a3cb1b.png"][/img][/p][p]SEGA Corporation has released Version 2.0 of Persona5: The Phantom X ("P5X"). To celebrate our first major update, we’re giving away items including Meta Jewels, which can be used for Contracts (gacha) and more.[/p][p] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/J-TPzn6V8Ow?si=mSsAsbwtI0Fo0eIe"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Z1EGITqqK68?si=RMbwaCJpMu6ZdhzY"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We've also got some brand-new promotional videos showing off the charm of this ultimate　school-life RPG. Take a look![/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]◆ Synopsis of Chapter 3: Unconditional Love[/b][/u][/p][p]“When did I abandon my true self?”[/p][p]The Protagonist has awakened the power of his other self, his Persona, and become a Phantom Thief.  He forms a band of Phantom Thieves who are also Persona users to save innocent people from evildoers who evade justice, stealing their distorted desires and changing their hearts.  As the Phantom Thieves grow increasingly famous among the public, a mysterious new teacher is appointed at the Protagonist’s school. The group remains on high alert as this figure lurks the school grounds and manipulates the students.  Meanwhile, Riko Tanemura of the Disciplinary Committee begins to notice the school's gradual distortions and questions what is truly happening...[/p][p] [img src="https://prcdn.freetls.fastly.net/release_image/5397/6758/5397-6758-2ec015b53ceebfadc55c7daa6403d03a-1500x844.jpg?width=1950&height=1350&quality=85%2C65&format=jpeg&auto=webp&fit=bounds&bg-color=fff"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://prcdn.freetls.fastly.net/release_image/5397/6758/5397-6758-c32be5d4351835a7948735e379a38078-1500x844.jpg?width=1950&height=1350&quality=85%2C65&format=jpeg&auto=webp&fit=bounds&bg-color=fff"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://prcdn.freetls.fastly.net/release_image/5397/6758/5397-6758-c5a0bb1f48e98fc7f998bf34b4c68205-1500x844.jpg?width=1950&height=1350&quality=85%2C65&format=jpeg&auto=webp&fit=bounds&bg-color=fff"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://prcdn.freetls.fastly.net/release_image/5397/6758/5397-6758-10ea6cecef485c1fd5f0d45c0fb28a89-1500x844.jpg?width=1950&height=1350&quality=85%2C65&format=jpeg&auto=webp&fit=bounds&bg-color=fff"][/img][/p][p][u][b]◆Special Website for Ver. 2.0 Now Live![/b][/u][/p][p]　The special site is jam-packed with information on exciting new content, including the latest addition to the Main Story and the new neighborhood, Kichijoji. That’s not all! Information about the “Real Kichijoji (Tokyo, Japan) Collabs” and other real-world events will be released on the site in the future. Give it a read now, and keep it bookmarked for future updates![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Ver.2.0 Special Site[/b] [/p][p][url="https://persona5x.com/lp/"]https://persona5x.com/lp/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]New version now available (with lots of loot to celebrate)![/b][/u][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/a5b5efec9a3a5a461eafad22b7b84fd0fe2c3a71.png"][/img][/p][p]Log in to the game for 7 days by Oct 22, 2025 6:59 PM (PDT) to receive 20 Platinum Tickets (usable for certain Contracts/gacha) and 20 Platinum Milicoins (usable for certain Arms Deals). In addition, you’ll also receive 60 Phantom Thief Cognitite Shards, a new item that can Awaken 5★ Phantom Thieves such as Ren Amamiya, Yui, and Minami Miyashita, along with 1,000 Meta Jewels.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]◆Comeback: 5★ Phantom Thief Ren Amamiya Returns![/b][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/e9a5ce898fe5ef44a1dd721abb608ede52fc2286.png"][/img]The 5★ Phantom Thief Ren Amamiya makes a Comeback to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts: The Phantom Magician, and the Ren Amamiya-only 5★ weapon Phoenix Dagger will be featured again in Most Wanted for Arms Deals: Silent Pistol. Don’t miss this chance to recruit Ren Amamiya to your team![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]◆Main Story Chapter 3: Unconditional Love Phase 1 released![/b][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/1a5ed4dcb6d77944dfe62825f8185947cb647b57.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u][b]Main Story Chapter 3: Unconditional Love Synopsis[/b][/u][/p][p]At Kokatsu Academy, where the protagonist is enrolled, an educational consultant arrives with plans to reform the school’s policies.[/p][p]Advocating a modern sense of “righteousness,” the consultant sets about improving the academy, but over time, the relationship between teachers and students begins to warp, and the school slowly transforms into something unsettling.[/p][p]Riko Tanemura, an exceptional student and chair of the disciplinary committee, while being swept up in the “distortions born of righteousness” brought about by these reforms, gradually starts to perceive the strange changes taking hold.[/p][p] [/p][p]How will the protagonist, Riko, and their allies stand against the “false righteousness” of an enemy who no one else recognizes as evil...?[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]▼Riko Tanemura (Code name: Wind) joins the group in Chapter 3.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/9577400f0f7e4786e9cfbbb1756ba58f8d7b9e08.jpg"][/img][/p][p] A support character who acts as the party’s commander and strategist, leading them to land flashy All-Out Attacks.[/p][p]Even when not targeting an enemy’s Weakness, she can lower the enemy’s Down Points, and at the start of battle, she boosts the entire party’s HP, Attack, and Defense. She also possesses the ability to increase All-Out Attack damage by as much as 60%.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]▼Character Introduction Movie[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gC8onJHoaEs"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]▼Character Skills Spotlight Movie[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZVevRsWS_Zk"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][u][b]◆Chapter 3: Unconditional Love Release Event![/b][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/071d8abd0a3df4a4a705c74b9bafd9cdd67ed394.png"][/img][/p][p]Play the new content added in Ver. 2.0 and complete goals to earn up to 1,280 Meta Jewels, as well as the event-exclusive item Mizuhiki Knots and other rewards. Collect Mizuhiki Knots to get the Riko Tanemura-only 4★ weapon Red Plum Blossom as well as the materials needed to fully upgrade it.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Duration: Until 6:59 PM on Oct 22, 2025 (PDT)[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]◆Addition of Kichijoji Area[/b][/u]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/872d7760ab5fd7774a2018d9ab8b8f778c1eed7a.png"][/img][/p][p]A new area called Kichijoji has been added alongside Chapter 3 of the Main Story. This new area brings more ways to enjoy city life, such as new part-time jobs, as well as the chance to meet new characters and learn their stories.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]◆New 5★ Phantom Thief: Ayaka Sakai![/b][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/3b7a2d538f66babd416a67a65a093f5406de14ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The new 5 ★Phantom Thief Ayaka Sakai will be featured in Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts, where the appearance rate for certain Phantom Thieves is increased. An exclusive weapon can be obtained through Arms Deals: Silent Pistol.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts: Dazzling Encore[/b][/p][p][b]Duration: Until 6:59 PM on Oct 8, 2025 (PDT)[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]▼Most Wanted Phantom Thief: 5★ Ayaka Sakai (Code Name: Chord)[/b][/p][p]Specializing in single-target buffs, she can turn an ally into a Costar, granting them an attack power boost, as well as significantly strengthening that ally’s Highlight effect. She's able to instantly activate an ally's Highlight, ignoring the Highlight Gauge and cooldown times, and significantly increase the damage dealt by that Highlight.[/p][p]Plus, she can pump up the Gauge's fill rate, allowing Highlights to be activated at a quicker tempo.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]▼Character Introduction Movie[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OtHae_5vj8k"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]▼Character Skills Spotlight Movie[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pLdgp2uOp1g"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]▼Ayaka Sakai's Synergy Story added![/b]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/78b3a94097f4abcb5a5aaf91ded8d1833e50d606.png"][/img][/p][p]The Synergy character interaction feature has been updated with a new story for Ayaka Sakai. Depending on your choices, you might even have a chance to date her! We hope you enjoy the story.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][u][b]◆New Feature to Earn Items: Tasks[/b][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/eea0ae2ea1586362f94339fad8d2b70809cdae28.png"][/img][/p][p]Once your Player Level reaches 20, you’ll be able to use the Tasks feature, where you can send eligible allies to complete Tasks and receive rewards after a set amount of time. There are different types of requests, such as daily and weekly, with different time requirements and rewards. Use this feature to get Meta Jewels, Thief's Cognitite Shards, and maybe even something special from an exclusive Task... [/p][p][/p][p][b]Official Site:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://persona5x.com/"]https://persona5x.com/[/url][/p][p][b]Official X:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://x.com/P5XOfficialWest"]https://x.com/P5XOfficialWest[/url][/p][p][b]Official Instagram:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/P5XOfficialWest/"]https://www.instagram.com/P5XOfficialWest/[/url][/p][p][b]Official Facebook: [/b][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/P5XOfficialWest"]https://www.facebook.com/P5XOfficialWest[/url][/p][p][b]Official YouTube: [/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@P5XOfficialWest"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Official Discord Server:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/cVDycxxmCK"]discord.gg/cVDycxxmCK[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061570"][/dynamiclink]🄫Perfect World Adapted from Persona5 🄫ATLUS. 🄫SEGA.[/p]

notes.title: Experience a New Phantom Journey in Persona5: The Phantom X
notes.content:
[h3]Dive deeper into the shadows of the Metaverse and unmask the story of P5X! The latest anime style JRPG in the Persona franchise by ATLUS is launching on Steam in June 26, 2025![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538637/3cd2d5a4bc51814ee2ca24bc78812a327e1b287e.png[/img]

[h3]Watch the special trailer video here, featuring all-new stories and in-game footages.[/h3]
[previewyoutube=kyUw2oNGqBQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Wishlist here:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061570/Persona5_The_Phantom_X

[h3]To celebrate reaching 200,000 pre-registrations, we are giving away special gift 'Athleisure Outfit'![/h3]
Next, let's aim for the special gifts for 300,000 pre-registrations: the 'Avatar Frame' and 'Profile Card'!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538637/8dd16208ee1d732a83a83734e93a6ce40abed071.png[/img]

[h3]Anime Expo 2025 Exhibition Confirmed![/h3]
P5X will appear at the SEGA ATLUS booth at Anime Expo 2025 from July 3rd to 5th, featuring numerous guests and giveaways.
Plus, you can enjoy a special live performance by Lyn Inaizumi during our panel event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538637/7d245a74199d176d93cf04963ff7a09c70bcd2a8.png[/img]

[h3]For more information on Persona5: The Phantom X, check our website and social media.[/h3]
Official Website - https://persona5x.com
Official X Account - https://www.x.com/P5XOfficialWest 
Official Facebook Account - https://www.facebook.com/P5XOfficialWest
Official Instagram Account - https://www.instagram.com/P5XOfficialWest

notes.title: Persona 3 Reload Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42950193/9b7ec3ca0e5d49b8dffcc985fe7123bea7f10c39.png[/img]
Hello Persona fans, 

A free demo of Persona 3 Reload, the latest title from the studio that produced Persona 5 Royal, is now available on Steam! Persona 3 Reload has delighted countless fans since its release last year, and now all players can experience the title for themselves! 

Step into the shoes of a transfer student who is thrusted into an unexpected fate. Awaken an incredible power and chase the mysteries of the Dark Hour, fight for your friends, and leave a mark on their memories forever. The demo allows you to play through the story’s opening, leading up to the first major boss battle against a formidable, large Shadow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42950193/e6246ac9dafc28f676b70e5ce66b86abeaa3cec5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42950193/c584aa09bb9773f018e0892e6a0abe30d570fa4b.gif[/img]

After playing the demo, you can carry over all progress to the full game upon purchase. Download the demo today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358440/Persona_3_Reload_Demo/

notes.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio Out Now!
notes.content:
The creative minds behind Persona 3, Persona 4, and Persona 5 proudly present ATLUS' latest fantasy RPG: [b]Metaphor: ReFantazio[/b]!

Join the Protagonist on a journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears, and awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679460/Metaphor_ReFantazio/

[previewyoutube=HnRzo99OqxU;full][/previewyoutube]--
[h2]Try the Prologue Demo![/h2]
Download and play the free Prologue Demo! The demo allows you to experience the beginning of the game, including exploring the first four dungeons, the ability to unlock seven Archetypes classes, and the opportunity to meet six followers. Best yet, your demo save data carries over to the full version.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130330/Metaphor_ReFantazio__Prologue_Demo/

notes.title: Persona 5 Royal is Out Now!
notes.content:
The Phantom Thieves of Hearts are ready for their latest conquest – PC!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42950193/84932051d0532fc3f1b2de243219103f3bf1060a.png[/img]

Don the mask and join the Phantom Thieves of Hearts as they stage grand heists, infiltrate the minds of the corrupt, and make them change their ways! 

Prepare for the award-winning RPG experience in this definitive edition of Persona 5 Royal, featuring a treasure trove of downloadable content included! 

Key Features: 
[list]
[*] Explore Tokyo, unlock Personas, customize your own personal Thieves Den, experience alternate endings, and more 
[*] Become the ultimate Phantom Thief and defy conventions, discover the power within, and fight for justice in the definitive version of Persona 5 Royal 
[*] Includes over 40 items of previously released downloadable content 
[*] Choose between Japanese and English VO 
[/list]

Persona 5 Royal is now available on Steam!   

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1687950/Persona_5_Royal/
